title: Hold an authority to conduct fundraising appeals
what: Collect money or goods for a charitable purpose (or sell tickets or devices said to raise money for one) only as, or for, the holder of a licence under the Act.

sources.title: Charitable Collections Act 1946 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: No person shall — (a) collect or attempt to collect any money or goods for any charitable purpose
